name: Zeon Corporation
summary: Zeon Corporation engages in the elastomer materials, specialty materials, and other businesses in Japan, North America, Europe, and Asia. The company offers synthetic rubbers, such as styrene-butadiene rubber, polybutadiene rubber, polyisoprene rubber, acrylonitrile-butadiene rubber, epichlorohydrin rubber, polyacrylate rubber, hydrogenated nitrile rubber, and NBR/PVC blend. It also provides synthetic latices; chemicals; aroma chemicals; specialty chemicals, including synthetic materials, industrial chemicals, and specialty solvents; electronic materials; lithium-ion rechargeable battery materials; cyclo olefin polymer and prototype production service; optical film; and carbon nanotube.
